note: Full published budget (2.4·n s per instance, the protocol behind the published numbers) on 30 stratified X instances (n 100–1000), PyVRP single-thread, one seed, one pinned core each: mean gap to best-known 0.34%. Racing in the earlier cuOpt (L4) runs, which had only 10% of that time, gives 0.31% (cuOpt still wins 5 instances). 4 instances hit best-known exactly; 25 of 30 are within 0.5%. Published: PyVRP 0.22%, HGS-CVRP 0.11% (all 100 instances, mean of 10 seeds). A 30-instance stratified subset and one seed is a fair but not identical comparison: the published mean is over all 100 and averages out seed luck. At 10% of the budget the same race averaged 0.49%. Verdict rule: reached = race mean ≤ 0.22%; close = ≤ 0.44%; otherwise not reached.
short: 30 CVRPLIB X instances at the full published time: PyVRP 0.34%, race with cuOpt 0.31% from best-known (published 0.11–0.22%).
